[[File:Itakura Raiden Shrine Honsha 1.JPG|thumb|220px|Raiden Shrine (群馬県板倉町)]]
'''Raiden Shrine''' (雷電神社) is a name shared by multiple {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}}s located primarily in the {{ill|Kantō region|en|Kantō region|qid=Q132480|lt=Kantō region}} of {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|qid=Q17|lt=Japan}}. These shrines are commonly dedicated to deities associated with protection against {{ill|Thunder|en|Thunder|qid=Q83301|lt=Thunder}}, although their enshrined deities and origins vary.

Similar shrines include {{ill|Raijin Shrine|ja|雷神社}} and {{ill|Den Shrine|ja|電神社}}.

== Gunma Prefecture ==

* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Itakura, Gunma)|ja|雷電神社 (板倉町)}} – Located in {{ill|Itakura, Gunma|en|Itakura, Gunma|qid=Q1203771|lt=Itakura, Gunma}}, [[Ōra District]], this shrine is also called Itakura Raiden Shrine. It holds an unofficial status as the head shrine of "Raiden Shrines" in the Kantō region. Enshrined deities include {{ill|Yakusanoikazuchi|en|Yakusanoikazuchi|qid=Q10892534|lt=Honoikazuchi-no-Ōkami}}, {{ill|Ōikazuchi-no-Ōkami|ja|大雷大神}}, and {{ill|Wakazuchi-no-Ōkami|ja|別雷大神}}.
* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Minami, Maebashi)|ja|雷電神社 (前橋市南町)}} – Located in [[Minami, Maebashi]] within {{ill|Maebashi|an|Maebashi|ar|مايه-باشي|arz|مايه باشى|az|Maebaşi|azb|مائه‌باشی، قونما|ban|Maebashi, Gunma|be|Маэбасі|bg|Маебаши|blk|မအဲဗဆိဝေင်ꩻ|ca|Maebashi|ce|Маэбаси|ceb|Maebashi Shi|cs|Maebaši|de|Maebashi|eo|Maebaŝi|es|Maebashi|et|Maebashi|eu|Maebashi|fa|مائه‌باشی، گونما|fi|Maebashi|fr|Maebashi|ga|Maebashi|gl|Maebashi|he|מאבאשי|hy|Մաեբասի|id|Maebashi, Gunma|it|Maebashi|ja|前橋市|ko|마에바시시|lb|Maebashi|lt|Maebašis|mg|Maebashi|ms|Maebashi|mzn|مائه‌باشی، گونما|nl|Maebashi|no|Maebashi|pl|Maebashi|pt|Maebashi|ro|Maebashi|ru|Маэбаси|sc|Maebashi|sh|Maebasi|simple|Maebashi|sr|Маебаши|sv|Maebashi|sw|Maebashi, Gunma|tg|Маебаши|th|มาเอบาชิ|tl|Maebashi|tr|Maebashi|tt|Маэбаси|tum|Maebashi|uk|Маебасі|ur|مایباشی|uz|Maebashi|vi|Maebashi|war|Maebashi|wuu|前桥市|zh|前橋市|zh_classical|前橋市|zh_min_nan|Maebasi-chhī|zh_yue|前橋|qid=Q201613|lt=Maebashi, Gunma}}, behind the main hall of {{ill|Maebashi Shinmeigu|ja|前橋神明宮}}.

== Tochigi Prefecture ==

* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Hiraide, Utsunomiya)|ja|雷電神社 (宇都宮市平出町)}} – Located in {{ill|Hiraide, Utsunomiya|ja|平出町 (宇都宮市)}}, this shrine is also called Hiraide Raiden Shrine. The shrine enshrines {{ill|Wakazuchi-no-Ōkami|ja|別雷之大神}} and nine other deities.
* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Hosoya, Utsunomiya)|ja|雷電神社 (宇都宮市細谷町)}} – Located in {{ill|Hosoya, Utsunomiya|ja|細谷町 (宇都宮市)}}.
* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Sukedo, Ashikaga)|ja|雷電神社 (足利市助戸東山町)}} – Located in {{ill|Sukedo, Ashikaga|ja|助戸東山町}}, {{ill|Ashikaga, Tochigi|en|Ashikaga, Tochigi|qid=Q374477|lt=Ashikaga, Tochigi}}.
* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Nogi, Tochigi)|ja|雷電神社 (野木町)}} – Located in {{ill|Nogi, Tochigi|en|Nogi, Tochigi|qid=Q1203180|lt=Nogi, Tochigi}}, originally part of {{ill|Yanaka|ja|谷中村|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yanaka Village|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11632602}}.

== Tokyo ==

* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Shinjuku)|ja|雷電神社 (新宿区)}} – Located at {{ill|Hanazono Shrine|en|Hanazono Shrine|qid=Q3126680|lt=Hanazono Shrine}} in {{ill|Shinjuku|en|Shinjuku|qid=Q179645|lt=Shinjuku, Tokyo}}. Merged with Hanazono Shrine in 1928 but still maintains its presence as {{ill|Raiden Inari Shrine|ja|雷電稲荷神社}}.

== Kanagawa Prefecture ==

* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Isehara)|ja|雷電神社 (伊勢原市)}} – Located in {{ill|Isehara, Kanagawa|en|Isehara, Kanagawa|qid=Q734520|lt=Isehara, Kanagawa}}, affiliated with {{ill|Hibita Shrine|ja|比々多神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hibita Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11547364}}.

== Aichi Prefecture ==

* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Tahara)|ja|雷電神社 (田原市)}} – Located in {{ill|Tahara, Aichi|en|Tahara, Aichi|qid=Q501891|lt=Tahara, Aichi}}.

== Mie Prefecture ==

* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Ise)|ja|雷電神社 (伊勢市)}} – Located in {{ill|Ise, Mie|en|Ise, Mie|qid=Q328067|lt=Ise, Mie}}. Considered a {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|式内社|lt=Shikinaisha}}, though later merged with the Hachioji Shrine.
